al01.help: What needs attention now, from the dashboard data you are allowed to see. Each line opens the same list as its source widget.
al01.title: Action Center

fl01.empty: No vehicles in your scope yet.
fl01.help: Vehicles by their current status, in your branch scope. Disposed vehicles are not part of the fleet. Click a segment for the vehicle list.
fl01.title: Fleet Status

fl02.empty: No vehicles in your scope yet.
fl02.help: Current vehicle status per branch (the branch the vehicle belongs to now). Click a bar for that branch's vehicles.
fl02.title: Fleet by Branch

fl03.help: Breakdowns not yet resolved. Running time = now − downtime start (or report time when no downtime start was recorded). This is a running duration, not MTTR.
fl03.title: Active Breakdowns

fl04.empty: No breakdowns reported in this period.
fl04.help: Breakdowns reported per month (company time zone), by severity.
fl04.title: Breakdown Trend

fl05.empty: No breakdowns reported in this period.
fl05.help: The 10 vehicles with the most breakdowns reported in the period. Click a bar for the list.
fl05.title: Vehicles with Most Breakdowns

fl06.empty: No document deadlines in the next 90 days.
fl06.help: The latest document per vehicle and type (by issue date) is assessed; OTHER documents one by one. Expiry dates and extension deadlines are counted separately, up to 90 days ahead.
fl06.title: Vehicle Document Deadlines

fl07.empty: No installed tires or serialized components.
fl07.help: Tires, rims and serialized components installed on vehicles now, with their installation cost: tires = issue-time unit cost of the Work Order that installed them; rims and serialized components = Goods Receipt purchase cost. Reused tires (no valuation) and items registered without a Work Order show "cost not available", never 0. This is not a book or net asset value. Non-serialized spare parts are not tracked as installed. Current position only.
fl07.note: Installation cost snapshot — not a book value.
fl07.title: Installed Components
fl07.untracked: Not tracked as installed: {{lines}} consumed non-serial part line(s) ({{products}} product(s)) —

fn01.empty: No service cost in this period.
fn01.help: Recognized service cost per month for every vehicle in scope, without a budget comparison. Parts: consumed cost (returns excluded) of Work Orders completed or closed, on the completion date. External services: Service Invoices (document value incl. tax) on the invoice date; cancelled ones excluded. External Work Orders: billed vendor invoice (document value) on the invoice date. Not included: estimates, payments, internal labor (no cost record), retread/repair (see Tire Service Cost). Months follow the company time zone; the running month is shown lighter.
fn01.laborExcluded: Internal labor is not included (no labor cost is recorded).
fn01.pendingMemos: Not yet invoiced: {{n}} completed external service memos (estimate {{amount}}).
fn01.pendingParts: Not yet recognized: parts on {{n}} open Work Orders ({{amount}}).
fn01.title: Service Cost

fn02.empty: No service cost in this period.
fn02.help: The 10 vehicles with the highest service cost in the period (same definition as Service Cost). Click a bar for its transactions.
fn02.title: Service Cost by Vehicle

fn03.empty: No service cost in this period.
fn03.help: Service cost by the Work Order's branch (recorded when the Work Order was created), same definition as Service Cost. Only Work Orders you can access are included.
fn03.title: Service Cost by Branch

fn04.help: Unpaid vendor invoices, Service Invoices and External WO invoices by days past the due date. Each source appears only with its view permission. External WO invoices have a free-text payment term, so they are shown as "No due date". Refunds are not netted.
fn04.title: Payables Aging

fn05.help: On-hand quantity × moving-average unit cost from the stock ledger, now, per Item Type (or per warehouse). The total covers stock WITH a recorded valuation only. Stock without one — used tire stock and stock held at no recorded unit cost — is shown apart as "pending valuation" (items and quantities per unit of measure) and is never valued at 0, at the new price or at the latest master price. Tires and rims are counted once, through their product stock. Stock in transit between warehouses is shown separately and not added. Quantities are never summed across units of measure. No history is kept, so no trend is shown.
fn05.kpi: Value of stock with recorded valuation
fn05.note: Current value only; quantities are not added across units of measure.
fn05.pendingNote: Not in the total — used stock: {{used}} item(s); no recorded unit cost: {{nocost}} item(s).
fn05.title: Inventory Value by Item Type

fn06.help: Refunds accepted by the vendor per month (date of acceptance), and refund requests still waiting for the vendor. A pending request has no amount until the vendor accepts it. Receipt of the money is not recorded.
fn06.note: Values are agreed refunds, not received payments.
fn06.title: Return-to-Vendor Refunds

fn07.anomaliesLink_one: {{count}} payment record outside the payment rule — view
fn07.anomaliesLink_other: {{count}} payment records outside the payment rule — view
fn07.anomaliesTitle: Payment records outside the payment rule
fn07.empty: No operating cost in this period.
fn07.help: Vehicles ranked by operating cost in the period: parts and tires actually consumed (issue-time unit cost, on the consumption date) + mechanic cost (work hours from start to QC, excluding holds and waiting for QC, × the mechanic's hourly rate at assignment, in the month the work interval ends; running work counts up to now) + external cost actually paid (External Work Order settlements and Service Invoice payments, on the payment date). Not the same basis as Service Cost, which uses document values. Mechanic cost needs recorded work time: a Work Order started before work times were recorded shows the mechanic cost as unavailable (never 0), and its vehicle total is marked "recorded costs only".
fn07.kpiTotalRecorded: Recorded operating cost in the period
fn07.note: Low cost does not mean efficient: a vehicle without activity has a cost of 0.
fn07.recordedOnlyNote_one: * {{count}} vehicle's total covers recorded costs only (mechanic cost unavailable or partial).
fn07.recordedOnlyNote_other: * {{count}} vehicles' totals cover recorded costs only (mechanic cost unavailable or partial).
fn07.title: Most Costly Vehicles

fn08.empty: No operating cost in this period.
fn08.help: Parts and tires consumed vs mechanic cost vs external cost paid, per month, on the same basis as Most Costly Vehicles (the period totals are equal). Click a month for its cost lines.
fn08.title: Monthly Cost Mix

mt01.help: Open maintenance schedules by the status the system computes from due date and odometer.
mt01.title: Maintenance Schedule Status

mt02.help: Schedules with status Overdue, most overdue first: days past the due date, then km past the due odometer (from the vehicle's current odometer).
mt02.title: Overdue Maintenance

mt03.help: Requests waiting for a decision or a Work Order (Draft, Submitted, Under Review, Approved).
mt03.title: Open Maintenance Requests

pr01.help: Open Purchase Requests and Purchase Orders by stage, in your warehouse scope. Each section appears only with its view permission.
pr01.title: Procurement Pipeline

pr02.help: Issued or partially received Purchase Orders past their expected delivery date.
pr02.title: Late Purchase Orders

pr03.empty: No committed Purchase Orders in this period.
pr03.help: Purchase Order total (document value incl. tax and freight) by order date, for approved, issued, received and closed POs. Drafts, pending approvals, rejected and cancelled POs are left out.
pr03.title: Committed Purchase Order Value

pr04.empty: No goods receipts in this period.
pr04.help: Per vendor, over posted goods receipts in the period: on time = received on or before the PO's expected delivery date (receipts without that date are left out of the rate); accepted = accepted quantity ÷ received quantity (accepted + rejected + damaged).
pr04.title: Vendor Performance

pr05.empty: No received Purchase Orders in this period.
pr05.help: For Purchase Orders whose first posted Goods Receipt is in the period: days SINCE PURCHASE REQUEST CREATION to the PO order date, from the order date to the first receipt, and in total (medians). The application records no Purchase Request approval date, so this is not measured from approval. POs without a Purchase Request have no PR step and are counted as excluded from it.
pr05.title: Procurement Cycle

tr01.help: Where the tires are now (scrapped, sold and lost tires are not counted). Visibility follows the tire's vehicle, warehouse or last branch.
tr01.title: Tire Status

tr02.help: Installed tires whose latest tread reading is at or below D_pull of the applicable active rule profile, plus used-tire inspections awaiting approval. Free-text notes are not used.
tr02.title: Tires Due Replacement

tr03.help: Retread and repair cycles sent to a vendor and not yet received, oldest first.
tr03.title: Tires at Vendor

tr04.empty: No retread or repair cost in this period.
tr04.help: Retread and repair cycle cost by the month the tire came back from the vendor. Not part of Service Cost.
tr04.title: Tire Service Cost

wh01.empty: No stock in your warehouses yet.
wh01.help: Stock rows (product × warehouse) by quantity on hand compared with the reorder point: out of stock (≤ 0), at or below the reorder point, normal, and in stock without a threshold ("threshold not set", never treated as 0).
wh01.title: Stock Health

wh02.askAuthorized: Ask a user authorized to adjust inventory to set them.
wh02.empty: No item at or below its threshold.
wh02.help: Stock rows at or below their threshold (the reorder point of the Warehouse Stock, compared with the quantity on hand), lowest stock first. Quantities are only compared within one unit of measure (filter by UOM); the ratio to the threshold is shown as supporting information. "Threshold not set" is listed separately and never treated as 0 — an intentional 0 is a set threshold. Items an open Work Order still needs from that warehouse are flagged.
wh02.notSet: {{n}} items in stock have no threshold set.
wh02.showNeeded: Show only items needed by Work Orders
wh02.thresholdHelp: Reorder point for this product in this warehouse. Leave empty for "not set"; 0 is an intentional threshold.
wh02.title: Low Stock

wh03.help: Open transfers, transfers in transit (flagged after the threshold) and transfers received recently with a discrepancy (received less than sent, damaged or lost).
wh03.title: Stock Transfers

wh04.empty: No valued stock movements in this period.
wh04.help: Value of stock coming in and going out per month (quantity × unit cost recorded on the movement), shown separately and never netted. Movements without a unit cost and stock opname variances are reported, not valued.
wh04.title: Stock Movement Value

wh05.help: Stock with quantity on hand whose last movement is older than 90 days, valued at moving-average cost. Stock without any movement record cannot be dated and is shown separately.
wh05.title: Slow-moving Stock

wh06.help: Products ranked by Used Times = number of different Work Orders that consumed them in the period (several entries in one Work Order count once). Consumed quantity is shown per product in its own unit and never added across units. Planned, requested or issued quantities are not used. Reused tires count when the Work Order installs them.
wh06.note: Used times = distinct Work Orders, not quantity.
wh06.title: Most Used Spareparts & Tires

wh07.empty: No Part Requests in this period.
wh07.help: Hours from a Part Request being submitted to its parts being issued, for requests issued in the period (median and 90th percentile, per month and warehouse), plus requests still open. With Work Order access: time Work Orders spent waiting for parts, from the recorded work intervals.
wh07.title: Part Fulfilment Lead Time
wh07.waitingPart: Work Orders waiting for parts: {{n}} WOs, {{hours}} h in total (median {{median}} h per wait).

ws01.help: Open Work Orders by status, in the workshops you can access (the same rule as the Work Order list). Drafts are shown separately.
ws01.title: Work Order Backlog

ws02.help: Open Work Orders by age since creation, in company-local days. Green ≤ 7 days, amber 8–14, red > 14. Time in the current status is not measured.
ws02.legend: Green: up to 7 days · Amber: 8–14 days · Red: more than 14 days
ws02.title: Open Work Order Aging

ws03.empty: No Work Orders completed in this period.
ws03.help: Work Orders completed or closed per month of completion, by maintenance type.
ws03.title: Completed Work Orders

ws04.empty: No measurable Work Orders in this period.
ws04.help: Median hours from start to completion of the Work Orders completed in each month. Pauses are not subtracted. This is not MTTR.
ws04.title: Work Order Turnaround

ws05.help: Current status of the workshop bays (inactive bays are left out).
ws05.title: Workspace Occupancy

ws06.empty: No Work Orders waiting for parts.
ws06.help: Work Orders in Waiting for Part, with their part requests not yet issued. Waiting time is counted from the oldest pending part request.
ws06.title: Work Orders Waiting for Parts

ws07.askAuthorized: Ask a user authorized to manage baselines.
ws07.baselineNotSet: Baseline not set for this maintenance type.
ws07.empty: No mechanic work recorded for this maintenance type in the period.
ws07.help: For one maintenance type: Work Orders completed in the period × each mechanic's average work hours per completed Work Order (only Work Orders whose work time was recorded from the start). Work hours = start to QC, plus rework, excluding holds, waiting for parts and QC. The status needs a baseline and at least the minimum number of samples; an average equal to the baseline meets it. Completed Work Orders without complete work-time history are excluded and counted; with no valid sample the average is unavailable, never 0.
ws07.note: Compare like-for-like work only: a higher average can reflect harder jobs. Status is shown from {{n}} valid samples.
ws07.noValidSamples: No Work Order with complete work-time history yet: averages are unavailable, not 0.
ws07.tipExcluded_one: {{count}} of {{total}} completed Work Orders excluded (no complete work-time history)
ws07.tipExcluded_other: {{count}} of {{total}} completed Work Orders excluded (no complete work-time history)
ws07.title: Mechanic Performance

ws08.empty: No completed Work Orders with a complete work history in this period.
ws08.help: Internal Work Orders completed in the period whose work history is complete: first pass = no rework after QC. Work Orders started before work time was recorded are excluded.
ws08.title: Rework / First-pass Rate
